name: ClawHub Skill Audit
description: Auto-runs an Opus 4.7 security audit against every newly installed clawhub skill (SKILL.md + bundled scripts) and writes an immutable JSON audit-trail entry. Optional Telegram alert on warn/block, optional quarantine on block.

anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for the auditor LLM. Defaults to the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.

auditModel.description: Model id for the security audit (default: claude-opus-4-7). The point of the plugin is the strong audit model — only override for cost-trial.

skillsDirs.description: Directories that may contain installed skills. Default: ['./skills', '$HOME/.openclaw/skills', '$HOME/.openclaw/workspace/skills'].

auditLogDir.description: Directory for the immutable audit-trail JSON records (default: $HOME/.openclaw/logs/skill-audits).

quarantineDir.description: If set, skills with verdict=block are moved here instead of remaining installed. Otherwise the audit only logs.

telegramBotToken.description: Telegram bot token for warn/block alerts (optional).

telegramAlertChatId.description: Telegram chat id to receive warn/block alerts.

pollIntervalMs.description: Filesystem-scan fallback interval in ms (default 30000). The SDK skills-change listener is the primary signal; this catches first-boot and out-of-band installs.

maxBytesPerFile.description: Cap on bytes read from any single skill file before it's truncated for the audit (default 65536).

maxFilesPerSkill.description: Cap on number of files read from a skill dir (default 25).
